# Stargate MCP Server

MCP server for Stargate. Agent-ready API for Stargate.

Hosted at [stargate.mcp.junct.dev/mcp](https://stargate.mcp.junct.dev/mcp). Free to use. No auth. No API key required.

Part of [Junct](https://junct.dev) — the agent-readiness layer for the crypto stack.

## Quick Start

Add to your MCP client config (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "stargate": {
      "url": "https://stargate.mcp.junct.dev/mcp",
      "transport": "streamable-http"
    }
  }
}
```

## About

This MCP server is **deterministically generated** from the Stargate API specification. Every tool maps 1:1 to a real API endpoint — no hallucinated endpoints, no phantom tools.

- **Protocol:** Stargate
- **Endpoint:** `https://stargate.mcp.junct.dev/mcp`
- **Transport:** Streamable HTTP
- **Auth:** None required
- **Documentation:** [stargate.mcp.junct.dev/llms.txt](https://stargate.mcp.junct.dev/llms.txt)
- **Server card:** [stargate.mcp.junct.dev/.well-known/mcp/server.json](https://stargate.mcp.junct.dev/.well-known/mcp/server.json)
